title: Two Handed Melee Weapon
wikitext:
'''Two handed melee weapon''' is a keyword which applies to the use of melee weapons which take up both [[Main Hand]] and [[Off Hand]] equipment slots. 

Weapons which count as Two Handed Melee Weapon:
*[[Staff]]
*[[List of Two Handed Axes|Two Handed Axes]]
*[[List of Two Handed Maces|Two Handed Maces]]
*[[List of Two Handed Swords|Two Handed Swords]]

==Passive skills==
There are [[passive skill]]s that grant two handed melee weapon bonuses.

===Physical damage with two handed melee weapons===
These passive skills grant increased [[physical damage]] with two handed melee weapons.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "two_handed_melee_physical_damage_+%"
}}

===Accuracy rating with two handed melee weapons===
These passive skills grant increased [[accuracy]] rating with two handed melee weapons.

{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "two_handed_melee_accuracy_rating_+%"
}}
===Attack speed with two handed melee weapons===
These passive skills grant increased [[attack speed]] with two handed melee weapons.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "two_handed_melee_attack_speed_+%"
}}
===Stun with two handed melee weapons===
These passive skills grant increased [[stun duration]] with two handed melee weapons.
{{Query base passive skills
|where=passive_skill_stats.id = "two_handed_melee_stun_duration_+%"
}}
===Other===
<!-- currently empty, but future passives not captured above will appear here - do not remove -->
{{Query base passive skills
|where=
  passive_skill_stats.id LIKE "%two_handed_melee%"
  AND passive_skill_stats.id NOT IN ("two_handed_melee_physical_damage_+%", "two_handed_melee_accuracy_rating_+%", "two_handed_melee_attack_speed_+%", "two_handed_melee_stun_duration_+%")
}}

===Cluster Jewel notable passive skills===
The following Cluster Jewel notable passives are related to two handed weapons: 
{{Passive skill table
|q_where=
  passive_skills.id LIKE "affliction%"
  AND passive_skills.stat_text LIKE "%two_handed_melee%"
|large=1
|stat_text=1
}}
